tail:
Batch 78 authoring is complete within its assigned scope: 13 A items, 2 B items, and frontmatter-only A/B pages. The batch evidence and all 15 item readiness records are recorded.

Seven items are **ready** and eight are **escalated** for incomplete proof obligations: the tower construction and standardization, cyclic-group goodness, Trotter’s S-equivalence proof, geometric basis realization, Alexander-one disk data, and the Whitehead satellite polynomial calculation. The square-knot counterexample now shows nonunit status by expanding the polynomial. I also made the good-group definition explicit about interpreting double-point loops in the input grope’s fundamental group, consistent with [Behrens et al., Definition 12.12](https://dokumen.pub/the-disc-embedding-theorem-0198841310-9780198841319.html).

**Checks:** manifest dependencies, content policy, strict proof contracts (15/15), proof layout (15 items, 25 steps), and the batch inventory reconciliation pass. The run-wide dependency check reports four mismatches outside batch 78. Source fetch verification is 7/8: FQ90’s complete text was retrieved and inspected, but its fetch stamp remains escalated after five recovery retries. Trotter is stamped, though its proof remains unread.

The run is still active at `1-scaffold` with 104/109 pairs covered; batch 78 remains listed as missing while artifact completion is deferred. The owner repair and recertification hold remains.
